mapper.select: SELECT distinct trade_id as tradeid FROM trd_product_deal where totle_trade_id=#{totleTradeId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and trade_status='01'
select PRE_TRADE_ID from TRDQUTO_MATCH_INFO where TRD_ID=#{tradeId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
select TOTLE_TRADE_ID from TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL where TRADE_ID=#{tradeId}

tpd.CPRICE_AMT) ownCpriceAmt, tpd.INT_AMT, tpda.LENDIN_FPRICE_AMT2 integrateIntAmt, /*nvl(tpda.OUR_FPRICE_AMT2, tpd.INT_AMT) ownIntAmt,*/ ifnull(tpda.OUR_FPRICE_AMT2, tpd.INT_AMT) ownIntAmt, tpd.EXER_YIELD, tpd.REMARK, tpd.TRADER, tpd.COUNTER_ID, tpd.COUNTER_TRADER, tpd.COUNTER_CONTACT,tpd.CHL_ID ,det.FEE_AMT ,tpda.ASSET_RECOMMAND_ORG ,tpd.PRIN_AMT ,ptpd.REFUND_RATE*100 as REFUND_RATE ,ptpd.REFUND_AMOUNT as REFUND_AMOUNT ,TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.BUSINESS_MODEL as businessModel ,tpda.ou_party_id as ouPartyId ,tpd.TRADER as ouTraderId ,match.exe_id as execid /*,decode(tpd.settle_speed,'0','01','1','02','2','03') as settleSpeedStr*/ ,(case tpd.settle_speed when '0' then '01' when '1' then '02' when '2' then '03' end) as settleSpeedStr ,tpd.delivery_type as deliveryType ,tpd.SHARE_AMT/100 as qty ,ttft.fee_amt as procedureAmt ,ttft1.fee_amt as settleServiceAmt ,tpd.clear_type as clearType /*,nvl(t2.PARTY_ABBR,tpda.ou_party_id) as ouPartyIdStr ,nvl(t3.real_name,tpd.TRADER) as ouTraderIdStr ,nvl(t1.counter_name,tpd.COUNTER_ID) as counterIdStr ,nvl(t4.TRADER_NAME,tpd.COUNTER_TRADER) as counterTraderStr*/ ,ifnull(t2.PARTY_ABBR,tpda.ou_party_id) as ouPartyIdStr ,ifnull(t3.real_name,tpd.TRADER) as ouTraderIdStr ,ifnull(t1.counter_name,tpd.COUNTER_ID) as counterIdStr ,ifnull(t4.TRADER_NAME,tpd.COUNTER_TRADER) as counterTraderStr , '1' as repoType ,ftp.term as term ,tpd.rate as rate /*,nvl(reg.SETT_CCY,ic.SETT_CCY) as settCcy ,nvl(reg.DIS_FACE_VALUE,ic.SHARE_CT_AMT) as disFaceValue*/ ,ifnull(reg.SETT_CCY,ic.SETT_CCY) as settCcy ,ifnull(reg.DIS_FACE_VALUE,ic.SHARE_CT_AMT) as disFaceValue ,tpd.m_delivery_type as mdeliveryType /*,nvl(reg.V_SETTLE_DATE,ic.V_SETTLE_DATE) as vsettleDate ,nvl(reg.M_SETTLE_DATE,ic.M_SETTLE_DATE) as msettleDate ,nvl(reg.M_INT_AMT,ic.M_INT_AMT) as mintAmt ,nvl(reg.M_TRADE_AMT,ic.M_TRADE_AMT) as mtradeAmt ,nvl(reg.ACT_REPO_TERM,ic.ACT_DAYS) as actRepoTerm*/ ,ifnull(reg.V_SETTLE_DATE,ic.V_SETTLE_DATE) as vsettleDate ,ifnull(reg.M_SETTLE_DATE,ic.M_SETTLE_DATE) as msettleDate ,ifnull(reg.M_INT_AMT,ic.M_INT_AMT) as mintAmt ,ifnull(reg.M_TRADE_AMT,ic.M_TRADE_AMT) as mtradeAmt ,ifnull(reg.ACT_REPO_TERM,ic.ACT_DAYS) as actRepoTerm ,tpd.TERM_TYPE as termType ,'A/365' as basis FROM TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL tpd LEFT JOIN TRD_DEAL_TOTAL_ADD tpda ON tpda.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = tpd.TOTLE_TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN PA_TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL ptpd ON ptpd.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = tpd.TOTLE_TRADE_ID left join TRD_TRADE_FEE_DETAIL det ON det.TRADE_ID = tpd.TOTLE_TRADE_ID and det.FEE_TYPE=#{B09} and det.IS_PAY_WITH_TRADE=#{Y} LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO PP ON tpd.PORTFOLIO_ID = PP.PORTFOLIO_ID left join trd_product_deal on TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = tpd.TOTLE_TRADE_ID left join fin_trade_product ftp on trd_product_deal.trade_id=ftp.finprod_id left join trdquto_match_info match on tpd.TOTLE_TRADE_ID=match.trd_id LEFT JOIN TRD_TRADE_FEE_TOTAL ttft ON tpd.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = ttft.TOTLE_TRADE_ID AND ttft.fee_type ='B06' LEFT JOIN TRD_TRADE_FEE_TOTAL ttft1 ON tpd.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = ttft1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID AND ttft1.fee_type = 'B08' left join MST_COUNTER_PARTY t1 on t1.counter_id=tpd.COUNTER_ID left join MST_CFETS_CUSTOMER_INFO t2 on t2.PARTY_ID= tpda.ou_party_id left join sys_user t3 on t3.user_name=tpd.TRADER left join MST_CFETS_CUSTOMER_TRADER t4 on t4.TRADER_ID=tpd.COUNTER_TRADER left join reg_fin_product_deal_total reg on reg.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = match.PRE_TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN ibu_quote_crep ic ON ic.quote_id = match.PRE_TRADE_ID WHERE tpd.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = #{totleTradeId}

select rp.pledge_finprod_id as finprodId, fp.finprod_market_id as finprodMarketId, fp.finprod_abbr as finprodAbbr, tpda.portfolio_id as portfolioId, pp.portfolio_name as portfolioName, sum(rp.pledge_number)/100 as pledgePrin, rp.pledge_ratio*100 as pledgeRate, mbvi.NETPRICE as firstNetPrice, fp.REGIST_ORG as repRegistOrg from FIN_DEAL_PLEDGE rp left join trd_product_deal deal on rp.finprod_id=deal.trade_id left join fin_product fp on fp.finprod_id=rp.pledge_finprod_id left join trd_product_deal_add tpda on tpda.trade_id=rp.finprod_id LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO PP ON tpda.PORTFOLIO_ID = PP.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT T2.SEC_ID, T2.PRICE, T2.NETPRICE FROM ( SELECT tmp1.SEC_ID, tmp1.value_source, MAX(tmp1.value_date) AS value_date FROM MST_BOND_VALUATION_INFO tmp1 LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT tmp2 ON tmp1.sec_id = tmp2.finprod_market_id WHERE 1 = 1 /* AND tmp1.value_date <= to_date(#{platDate},'yyyy-MM-dd')*//*估值行情.日期 小于等于 平台日*/ AND tmp1.value_date <= STR_TO_DATE(#{platDate},'%Y-%m-%d') AND tmp1.value_source = ( CASE WHEN tmp2.trade_market IN (#{TRADEPLACE03},#{TRADEPLACE04}) THEN 'CSD' ELSE 'CBC' END) GROUP BY tmp1.sec_id, tmp1.value_source ) T1 LEFT JOIN MST_BOND_VALUATION_INFO T2 ON T1.SEC_ID = T2.SEC_ID AND T1.value_source = T2.value_source AND T1.VALUE_DATE = T2.VALUE_DATE ) mbvi/*以上获取债券小于等于平台日的最新估值行情*/ ON fp.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = mbvi.SEC_ID where deal.totle_trade_id=#{totleTradeId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} group by rp.pledge_finprod_id, fp.finprod_market_id, fp.finprod_abbr, tpda.portfolio_id, pp.portfolio_name, rp.pledge_ratio, mbvi.NETPRICE, fp.REGIST_ORG

SELECT distinct /*NVL(T9.party_abbr,tpda.ou_party_id) traderidStr, NVL(T10.REAL_NAME,T1.TRADER) trader, NVL(T11.COUNTER_NAME,T1.COUNTER_ID) counterIdStr, NVL(T12.TRADER_NAME,T1.COUNTER_TRADER) counterTrader,*/ ifnull(T9.party_abbr,tpda.ou_party_id) traderidStr, ifnull(T10.REAL_NAME,T1.TRADER) trader, ifnull(T11.COUNTER_NAME,T1.COUNTER_ID) counterIdStr, ifnull(T12.TRADER_NAME,T1.COUNTER_TRADER) counterTrader, T7.exe_id tradeId, T1.PS ps, '1' as repoType, T1.TRADE_MARKET tradeMarket, /*TO_CHAR(T1.TRADE_DATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') tradeDate,*/ DATE_FORMAT(1.TRADE_DATE,'%Y-%m-%d') /* DECODE(T1.SETTLE_SPEED,0,'01',1,'02','2','03') settleSpeed,*/ (case T1.SETTLE_SPEED when 0 then '01' when 1 then '02' when '2' then '03' end) settleSpeed, ftp.term repoTerm, T1.rate*100 as tradeYield, /*nvl(T1.CCY,T.CCY) secCcy, nvl(T8.SETT_CCY,ic.SETT_CCY) as settCcy,*/ ifnull(T1.CCY,T.CCY) secCcy, ifnull(T8.SETT_CCY,ic.SETT_CCY) as settCcy, T.Trade_Amt tradeAmt, pledges.faceValue as faceValue, pledges.disFaceValue as disFaceValue, T1.clear_type clearType, T1.Delivery_Type deliveryType, T1.m_delivery_type as mdeliveryType, ttft.fee_amt trdFeeAmt, ttft1.fee_amt settleFeeAmt, /*to_char(nvl(T8.V_SETTLE_DATE,ic.V_SETTLE_DATE),'yyyy-MM-dd')as vsettleDate, to_char(nvl(T8.M_SETTLE_DATE,ic.M_SETTLE_DATE),'yyyy-MM-dd') as msettleDate,*/ DATE_FORMAT(ifnull(T8.V_SETTLE_DATE,ic.V_SETTLE_DATE),'%Y-%m-%d')as vsettleDate, DATE_FORMAT(ifnull(T8.M_SETTLE_DATE,ic.M_SETTLE_DATE),'%Y-%m-%d') as msettleDate ftp.m_int_amt as intAmt, ftp.m_trade_amt as mtradeAmt, ftp.ACT_CAP_DAYS as actRepoTerm, ftp.TERM_TYPE as termType, ftp.basis as basis, T1.remark as remark, /*nvl(T8.dip_type,ic.dip_type) as distriType*/ ifnull(T8.dip_type,ic.dip_type) as distriType FROM trd_product_deal T left join TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL T1 on T.totle_trade_id=T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID left join FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT ftp on T.finprod_id=ftp.finprod_id LEFT JOIN trd_trade_fee_detail ttft ON T.trade_id = ttft.trade_id AND ttft.fee_type =#{feeType06} LEFT JOIN trd_trade_fee_detail ttft1 ON T.trade_id = ttft1.trade_id AND JOIN TRD_DEAL_TOTAL_ADD tpda ON tpda.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN MST_CFETS_CUSTOMER_INFO T9 ON T9.PARTY_ID = tpda.ou_party_id LEFT JOIN SYS_USER T10 ON T10.USER_NAME = T1.TRADER LEFT JOIN MST_COUNTER_PARTY T11 ON T11.COUNTER_ID = T1.COUNTER_ID LEFT JOIN MST_CFETS_CUSTOMER_TRADER T12 ON T12.trader_id = T1.COUNTER_TRADER /*LEFT JOIN ibu_quote_crep ic ON ic.quote_id = nvl(T7.PRE_TRADE_ID,T1.B_TRADE_ID)*/ LEFT JOIN ibu_quote_crep ic ON ic.quote_id = ifnull(T7.PRE_TRADE_ID,T1.B_TRADE_ID) left join (select pledge.finprod_id,sum(pledge.pledge_number/100) as faceValue, sum(pledge.pledge_number*pledge.pledge_ratio*100) as disFaceValue from FIN_DEAL_PLEDGE pledge group by pledge.finprod_id)pledges on T.trade_id=pledges.finprod_id WHERE T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = #{totleTradeId} and T.trade_id=#{busiCode} AND T1.TRADE_STATUS = #{TRADE_STATUS01}

select rp.pledge_finprod_id as finprodId, fp.finprod_market_id as finprodMarketId, fp.finprod_abbr as finprodAbbr, tpda.portfolio_id as portfolioId, pp.portfolio_name as portfolioName, sum(rp.pledge_number*rp.pledge_ratio)/100 as pledgePrin, rp.pledge_ratio*100 as pledgeRate, mbvi.NETPRICE as firstNetPrice, fp.REGIST_ORG as repRegistOrg from FIN_DEAL_PLEDGE rp left join trd_product_deal deal on rp.finprod_id=deal.trade_id left join fin_product fp on fp.finprod_id=rp.pledge_finprod_id left join trd_product_deal_add tpda on tpda.trade_id=rp.finprod_id LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO PP ON tpda.PORTFOLIO_ID = PP.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT T2.SEC_ID, T2.PRICE, T2.NETPRICE FROM ( SELECT tmp1.SEC_ID, tmp1.value_source, MAX(tmp1.value_date) AS value_date FROM MST_BOND_VALUATION_INFO tmp1 LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT tmp2 ON tmp1.sec_id = tmp2.finprod_market_id WHERE 1 = 1 /*AND tmp1.value_date <= to_date(#{platDate},'yyyy-MM-dd')*//*估值行情.日期 小于等于 平台日*/ AND tmp1.value_date <= STR_TO_DATE(#{platDate},'%Y-%m-%dd') AND tmp1.value_source = ( CASE WHEN tmp2.trade_market IN (#{TRADEPLACE03},#{TRADEPLACE04}) THEN 'CSD' ELSE 'CBC' END) GROUP BY tmp1.sec_id, tmp1.value_source ) T1 LEFT JOIN MST_BOND_VALUATION_INFO T2 ON T1.SEC_ID = T2.SEC_ID AND T1.value_source = T2.value_source AND T1.VALUE_DATE = T2.VALUE_DATE ) mbvi/*以上获取债券小于等于平台日的最新估值行情*/ ON fp.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = mbvi.SEC_ID where deal.trade_id=#{busiCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} group by rp.pledge_finprod_id, fp.finprod_market_id, fp.finprod_abbr, tpda.portfolio_id, pp.portfolio_name, rp.pledge_ratio, mbvi.NETPRICE, fp.REGIST_ORG
